summary: A2A callers use AgentPort as a verified service-business gateway by mapping A2A task classes onto existing AgentPort discovery, action-intent, lifecycle, execution, and receipt primitives.

resources.purpose: Locate the AgentPort gateway and advertised resources.
Distinguish public read, operational read, and consent-gated state-changing behavior.
Follow the existing safe action sequence instead of inventing A2A-specific action rules.
Prevent browsing, model memory, or task text from replacing gateway truth.
Preserve portable ticket/reservation refs when a gateway outcome creates or updates a commitment.
Verify signed gateway receipts when the profile is published.

taskMapping.authorityRule: No user-action authority is required for public verified facts, but verification and capability must come from AgentPort records.
taskMapping.receiptRule: No ActionReceipt is expected for read-only facts.

taskMapping.authorityRule: Preparation creates a bounded approval package only; it does not authorize execution.
taskMapping.receiptRule: Preparation returns lifecycle refs, not a backend outcome receipt.

taskMapping.authorityRule: Lifecycle reads and acknowledgements do not prove user consent or receipt validity.
taskMapping.receiptRule: Delivery acknowledgement means the host consumed a result; it is not receipt verification.

taskMapping.authorityRule: Execution requires the compiled intent id, approved action-intent hash, exact user approval, userConsent true, and any gateway-required authority evidence.
taskMapping.receiptRule: Only the AgentPort gateway can return the business outcome and ActionReceipt.

taskMapping.authorityRule: A2A callers may carry receipt refs, but must not mint or edit receipt facts.
taskMapping.receiptRule: Receipt validity is derived from gateway payload/hash/signature expectations, not from the caller's task state.

forbiddenShortcuts.rule: A2A action.execute must not call a state-changing AgentPort tool before compile_action_intent returns a ready approval package.
A2A caller task text cannot stand in for exact user approval or userConsent.
High-assurance actions cannot be upgraded from none to signed or verified-mandate by caller assertion.
A2A caller-supplied ActionReceipt fields are untrusted and must be ignored or rejected.
A result-delivery acknowledgement must not be treated as gateway receipt verification.

resultSemantics.taskStateRule: A2A task state reports orchestration progress only.
resultSemantics.businessOutcomeRule: Business outcome comes only from AgentPort gateway tool results and existing backend responses.
resultSemantics.receiptRule: Portable proof requires AgentPort ActionReceipt data and configured trust verification when present.
